outcome: Launch three measured engagement journeys to reduce onboarding drop-off or abandoned bookings using consented behavioral events and controlled messaging.
overview: Help banks complete customer activation and travel companies recover abandoned booking journeys. The proposed service connects approved behavioral events, defines three audience journeys and measures outcomes against a holdout. Deliverables include the event plan, consent mapping, three workflows, approved message templates and a customer-owned performance report.
kpi: Completed activation or bookings per eligible customer, measured against a holdout group.
scope: Planning estimate: six to eight weeks for three journeys, two channels and one app or website. Sequence: baseline, event validation, consent testing, journey design, sandbox demonstration, controlled launch and performance review. Allow at least one complete conversion cycle before conclusions. Additional apps, brands, migrations or channel contracts extend the estimate.
